metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the door angel exercise.

It's perfect to use throughout the day to stretch tight muscles that may leading to forward, rounded shoulder and back posture. 

It can be done at home (and work!), requires no equipment, and may help improve bad back posture within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
